entries.43372043241f1e7b: Its main business is the wholesale of marine products, selling fresh, frozen and processed marine products to intermediate wholesalers and others. Its ancillary businesses are cold storage warehousing and real estate leasing.
entries.4500bdf712527c1d: It receives consignments from producers and others to sell fresh, frozen and processed marine products, and also purchases them, selling them by auction and other methods. It also provides cold storage of marine products and leases real estate such as apartment buildings.

entries.5c4ad76e3f9d386d: As a wholesaler in the central wholesale market, its basic policy is to contribute to the enrichment and stability of local food life through a stable supply of safe, secure and high-quality marine products, appropriate price formation, efficient logistics functions and accurate provision of information, and to establish a solid management base by strengthening sales capabilities and improving management efficiency.

entries.8acca91393b37ce3: This is the cold storage warehouse division. It stores fresh, frozen and processed marine products and similar goods for marine product companies and wholesale market intermediaries. It has a market cold storage warehouse and a Hibino cold storage warehouse in Atsuta Ward, Nagoya. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥538 million.

entries.95097b3ce2a532b7: Its strength lies in combining its position as a wholesaler in the Nagoya Central Wholesale Market with a cold storage system adjacent to the market. It operates the Market Cold Storage Warehouse and the Hibino Cold Storage Warehouse. The Hibino Cold Storage Warehouse has an ultra-low-temperature room, so it can handle sales and storage of fresh, frozen and processed marine products within the same market area.

entries.d9c6260fec78724b: Wholesale division. As a seafood wholesale business licensed by the Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries under the Wholesale Market Act, it receives consignments and makes purchases of fresh, frozen and processed seafood from producers across Japan, and sells them to intermediate wholesalers and others at the Nagoya City Central Wholesale Market by methods such as auction sales. Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥36,620 million.
